justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/compilechain/CompileChainStage.java and ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/main/JITWatchUI.java. The target package contains only one class and has a single observed inbound reference, JITWatchUI.openCompileChain(). CompileChainStage depends on shared UI/core packages (CompileChainWalker, CompileNode, CompilationChooser, IStageAccessProxy, IRedrawable, RateLimitedResizeListener, UserInterfaceUtil, JavaFX), and several of those are reused across the repo (e.g., UserInterfaceUtil in 35 files, RateLimitedResizeListener in 4, CompilationChooser in 3), so the package is a low-incoming leaf rather than a package depending on less stable packages.
